verified_context: A Dutch oncology usability report describes a downstream EHR handoff discrepancy and bounded perceived-workload findings. The study did not establish patient benefit or a general error rate.
visual_idea: Photorealistic editorial still life of a quiet clinical workspace: blank form on a clipboard, computer keyboard and one hand pointing to an empty field. The empty field suggests attention to missing information without depicting the actual research, institution or patient record.
placement: Homepage lead, Health systems desk and article hero, each with a visible illustrative-image caption.
constraints: Quiet Laboratory soft daylight and restrained white, ink and teal palette. No legible patient information, clinical result, identifiable study participant or institution. No logos, fabricated labels, medical claim, actual study-site implication or clinical-outcome implication.
